title: Add a Contact page and fix Contact navigation to show author details and social links

requirements.text: Create a dedicated Contact page route (e.g., `/contact`) and update the app router so it is accessible via navigation.

quotes: when I click on contact I am unable to get my details with my name and my book name Shining Gaze - A search for the unknown  Instagram link https://www.instagram.com/shining_starsana/ linkedin link https://www.linkedin.com/in/sana-khan-919353159/

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting `/contact` renders a Contact page within the existing AppLayout.
The Contact page can be reached via the app navigation without relying on a mailto link.

requirements.text: Update the top navigation 'Contact' action so it navigates to the new Contact page route (instead of using a `mailto:` link).

quotes: when I click on contact I am unable to get my details with my name and my book name Shining Gaze - A search for the unknown  Instagram link https://www.instagram.com/shining_starsana/ linkedin link https://www.linkedin.com/in/sana-khan-919353159/

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Contact' in the header navigates to `/contact` using the existing router navigation (no `mailto:` link in the header Contact action).

requirements.text: On the Contact page, display the following author details as visible page content: Name: "Sana Khan"; Book name: "Shining Gaze - A search for the unknown"; Instagram link: https://www.instagram.com/shining_starsana/; LinkedIn link: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sana-khan-919353159/.

acceptanceCriteria: The Contact page visibly shows the name "Sana Khan" and the book title exactly as: "Shining Gaze - A search for the unknown".
The Instagram and LinkedIn URLs are rendered as clickable links.
External social links open in a new tab/window and include appropriate `rel` attributes (e.g., `noopener noreferrer`).

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not modify the immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: No backend changes or new Motoko methods are required for this fix.
No third-party authentication or external API integrations are required.
